mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_health_reports (report_date, status, provider, model, prompt_version, summary, result_json, error_code, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, duration_ms, created_at) VALUES (#{report.reportDate}, #{report.status}, #{report.provider}, #{report.model}, #{report.promptVersion}, #{report.summary}, #{report.resultJson}, #{report.errorCode}, #{report.inputTokens}, #{report.outputTokens}, #{report.totalTokens}, #{report.durationMs}, #{report.createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), provider = VALUES(provider), model = VALUES(model), prompt_version = VALUES(prompt_version), summary = VALUES(summary), result_json = VALUES(result_json), error_code = VALUES(error_code), input_tokens = VALUES(input_tokens), output_tokens = VALUES(output_tokens), total_tokens = VALUES(total_tokens), duration_ms = VALUES(duration_ms), created_at = VALUES(created_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id, report_date, status, provider, model, prompt_version, summary, result_json, error_code, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, duration_ms, created_at FROM ai_health_reports WHERE report_date = #{reportDate}

SELECT id, report_date, status, provider, model, prompt_version, summary, result_json, error_code, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, duration_ms, created_at FROM ai_health_reports WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, report_date, status, provider, model, prompt_version, summary, result_json, error_code, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, duration_ms, created_at FROM ai_health_reports ORDER BY report_date DESC, id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'online' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS online_count FROM servers WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT id AS server_id, name AS server_name, agent_status AS agent_status, last_heartbeat_at AS last_heartbeat_at FROM servers WHERE deleted = 0 AND status <> 'online' ORDER BY last_heartbeat_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT AVG(m.cpu_percent) AS avg_cpu_percent, MAX(m.cpu_percent) AS max_cpu_percent, AVG(m.memory_percent) AS avg_memory_percent, MAX(m.memory_percent) AS max_memory_percent, AVG(m.disk_percent) AS avg_disk_percent, MAX(m.disk_percent) AS max_disk_percent FROM metrics m JOIN servers s ON s.id = m.server_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE m.collected_at >= #{startTime} AND m.collected_at < #{endTime}

SELECT m.server_id FROM metrics m JOIN servers s ON s.id = m.server_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE m.collected_at >= #{startTime} AND m.collected_at < #{endTime} AND m.cpu_percent IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.cpu_percent DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.server_id FROM metrics m JOIN servers s ON s.id = m.server_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE m.collected_at >= #{startTime} AND m.collected_at < #{endTime} AND m.memory_percent IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.memory_percent DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.server_id FROM metrics m JOIN servers s ON s.id = m.server_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE m.collected_at >= #{startTime} AND m.collected_at < #{endTime} AND m.disk_percent IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.disk_percent DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_triggered, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN level = 'critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS critical_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN level = 'warning' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS warning_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'resolved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS resolved_count FROM alert_records WHERE triggered_at >= #{startTime} AND triggered_at < #{endTime}
